lines.text: بالجدْول الثالث في الزُّهَرَة {ov:ص} وفي عطارد {ov:رع} فما حصل معك بَعْدَ إِلْقاء الدَّوْر اذا كان اكثر من
lines.plain: بالجدْول الثالث في الزُّهَرَة ص وفي عطارد رع فما حصل معك بَعْدَ إِلْقاء الدَّوْر اذا كان اكثر من

lines.text: الدَّوْر فأَدْخِلْه في تلك الجداول وخُذْ ما بإِزائه في الجدْول التاسع المرسوم بحِصَص العرض للجميع
lines.plain: الدَّوْر فأَدْخِلْه في تلك الجداول وخُذْ ما بإِزائه في الجدْول التاسع المرسوم بحِصَص العرض للجميع

lines.text: فما حصل لك من الدقائق فاعرف مقداره من ستّين فما كان فخذ *بقَدْره من الميْل الذي أَثْبَتَّ فما{mL:f. 119,r.}
lines.plain: فما حصل لك من الدقائق فاعرف مقداره من ستّين فما كان فخذ *بقَدْره من الميْل الذي أَثْبَتَّ فما

lines.text: حصل فهو العرض الاوّل فاحفَظْه فإِن كان عدد المركز المعدَّل بزيادة الكوكب الذي عرَفْتَ به دقائق
lines.plain: حصل فهو العرض الاوّل فاحفَظْه فإِن كان عدد المركز المعدَّل بزيادة الكوكب الذي عرَفْتَ به دقائق

lines.text: الجدْول التاسع وحاصّة الكوكب المعدَّلة يقَعَانِ جميعًا في نصف واحد أيّ النِّصْفَيْن كان إِمّا الأَعْلَى وإِمّا{mR:5}
lines.plain: الجدْول التاسع وحاصّة الكوكب المعدَّلة يقَعَانِ جميعًا في نصف واحد أيّ النِّصْفَيْن كان إِمّا الأَعْلَى وإِمّا

lines.text: الاسفل فإِنّ ذلك العرض الذي اثبتَّ جَنُوبيّ وان اختلفا وكان احدهما في نصف والآخر في نصف آخرَ
lines.plain: الاسفل فإِنّ ذلك العرض الذي اثبتَّ جَنُوبيّ وان اختلفا وكان احدهما في نصف والآخر في نصف آخرَ

lines.text: فإِنّ ذلك العَرْض شَماليّ فاعرِفه بجهته ثمّ خذ المَرْكَز المعدَّل بالجَدْوَل الثالث{n:1} أمّا في الزُّهَرة فكما
lines.plain: فإِنّ ذلك العَرْض شَماليّ فاعرِفه بجهته ثمّ خذ المَرْكَز المعدَّل بالجَدْوَل الثالث أمّا في الزُّهَرة فكما

lines.text: هو على حاله وأمّا في عُطارد فبزيادة {ov:قف} فأَدْخِل ما حصل لك من المركز بعد إِلْقاء الدَّوْر إِن فاقَه
lines.plain: هو على حاله وأمّا في عُطارد فبزيادة قف فأَدْخِل ما حصل لك من المركز بعد إِلْقاء الدَّوْر إِن فاقَه

lines.text: في تلك الجداول ايضًا وخذ ما بإِزائه من دقائق الحِصَص المرسومة في الجدْول التاسع فأَثْبِتْها في
lines.plain: في تلك الجداول ايضًا وخذ ما بإِزائه من دقائق الحِصَص المرسومة في الجدْول التاسع فأَثْبِتْها في

lines.text: موضِعَيْن واعرِف مقدار احد الموضعَيْن من ستّين فما كان فخذ بقدْره من الانحراف فما بلغ فهو العرض{mR:10}
lines.plain: موضِعَيْن واعرِف مقدار احد الموضعَيْن من ستّين فما كان فخذ بقدْره من الانحراف فما بلغ فهو العرض

lines.text: الثاني فأثبِتْه فإِن كان العَدَد الذي عرفتَ به هذه الدقائق وقَع في النصف الأعْلَى والحاصّة المعدَّلة اقلّ
lines.plain: الثاني فأثبِتْه فإِن كان العَدَد الذي عرفتَ به هذه الدقائق وقَع في النصف الأعْلَى والحاصّة المعدَّلة اقلّ

lines.text: من {ov:قف} فإِنّ الذي حصَل لك من العرض الثاني شَماليّ{n:2} وان كانت الحاصّة اكثر من {ov:قف} فإِنّ العرض
lines.plain: من قف فإِنّ الذي حصَل لك من العرض الثاني شَماليّ وان كانت الحاصّة اكثر من قف فإِنّ العرض

lines.text: جَنوبيّ{n:3} وان كان واقعًا في النصف الاسفل والحاصَّة اقلّ من {ov:قف} فإِنّ العرض جَنوبيّ{n:4} وان كانت
lines.plain: جَنوبيّ وان كان واقعًا في النصف الاسفل والحاصَّة اقلّ من قف فإِنّ العرض جَنوبيّ وان كانت

lines.text: اكثر من {ov:قف} فإِنّه شَماليّ{n:5} ثمّ خُذْ من تلك الدقائق التي اثبَتَّها في الموْضِع الآخر ان كان حسابك
lines.plain: اكثر من قف فإِنّه شَماليّ ثمّ خُذْ من تلك الدقائق التي اثبَتَّها في الموْضِع الآخر ان كان حسابك

lines.text: للزُّهَرَة فسُدْسها وهو ابدًا شماليّ وان كان حسابك لعُطارِدَ فنِصْفها ورُبْعها وهو ابدًا جَنوبيّ فما حصل{mR:15}
lines.plain: للزُّهَرَة فسُدْسها وهو ابدًا شماليّ وان كان حسابك لعُطارِدَ فنِصْفها ورُبْعها وهو ابدًا جَنوبيّ فما حصل

lines.text: من هذه العُروض الثلثة في جهة واحدة فاجمَعْها وان خالَفَ فأَلْقِ الاقلَّ من الاكثر واعرِف جِهة ما
lines.plain: من هذه العُروض الثلثة في جهة واحدة فاجمَعْها وان خالَفَ فأَلْقِ الاقلَّ من الاكثر واعرِف جِهة ما

lines.text: يَبْقَى فهو الحاصل من العرض للكوكب في الجهة التي يحصُل فيها ﴿ واعلَم ﴾ أنّ جميع عرض زُحَلَ في
lines.plain: يَبْقَى فهو الحاصل من العرض للكوكب في الجهة التي يحصُل فيها ﴿ واعلَم ﴾ أنّ جميع عرض زُحَلَ في

lines.text: الشَّمال على ما وجَده بطلميوس {ov:ج ب}{n:6} وفي الجنوب {ov:ج ه}{n:7} وجميع عرض المشتري في الشمال {ov:ب د}{n:8} وفي
lines.plain: الشَّمال على ما وجَده بطلميوس ج ب وفي الجنوب ج ه وجميع عرض المشتري في الشمال ب د وفي

lines.text: الجَنوب {ov:ب ح}{n:9} وجميع عرض المِرِّيخ في الشمال {ov:د كا}{n:10} وفي الجَنوب {ov:ز ز}{n:11}. *وجميع عرض الزهرة في{mL:f. 119,v.}
lines.plain: الجَنوب ب ح وجميع عرض المِرِّيخ في الشمال د كا وفي الجَنوب ز ز. *وجميع عرض الزهرة في

lines.text: الشَّمال والجَنوب بالسَّوِيَّة {ov:ح نو}{n:12} وجميع عرض عُطارد في الشمال والجَنوب بالسويّة {ov:د يح}{n:13} ايضًا. ﴿ وإِن{mR:20}
lines.plain: الشَّمال والجَنوب بالسَّوِيَّة ح نو وجميع عرض عُطارد في الشمال والجَنوب بالسويّة د يح ايضًا. ﴿ وإِن

lines.text: اردتَّ أن تعلَم ﴾ هَلِ الكوكب صاعِد ام هابط في الجهة التي هو فيها فقَوِّمْ عرضه بَعْدَ عشْرة أيّام
lines.plain: اردتَّ أن تعلَم ﴾ هَلِ الكوكب صاعِد ام هابط في الجهة التي هو فيها فقَوِّمْ عرضه بَعْدَ عشْرة أيّام

notes.text: 1) Cod. السادس — 2) Cod. جنوبى — 3) Cod. شمالى — 4) Cod. شمالى — 5) Cod. جنوبى — 6) Cod.
ح ب — 7) Cod. لج ه — 8) Cod. يج — 9) Cod. يز ح — 10) Cod. (ut Plato) و — 11) Cod. (ut Plato)
وايضا — 12) Cod. sine punctis. — 13) Cod. s. p.

observations: L01, L02, L03, L07, L08, L09, L13, L14, L18, L19, L21: long joins (مـن at the end of L01; للجميـع at the end of L02; فـما at the end of L03; أمّـا on L07; فاقَـه at the end of L08; دقائـق and فأَثْبِتْهـا on L09; اقـلّ and فـإِنّ on L13; الموْضِـع on L14; وجميـع on L18; the second وجميـع and الزهـرة on L19; بَعْـدَ on L21) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of المَرْكَز (L07).

The page has 21 lines, which run the full measure (116 to 543 pt; the block leans a little, from 116 to 540 pt on L01 to 119 to 543 pt on L21), and three lines of notes. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20. The folio number «f. 119,r.» stands in the left margin beside L03, where the asterisk stands before بقَدْره; the folio number «f. 119,v.» stands in the left margin beside L19, where the asterisk stands before the second وجميع, after a full stop. A full stop stands on L20 after ايضًا. Under a rule of 94 pt (126.0 to 220.3 pt) stand thirteen notes in three lines, the first set in (146.5 to 540.7 pt), the second and the third from the left edge (119 to 543 pt and 119 to 324 pt); the last is closed by a full stop.

The brackets: on L17 the word واعلَم stands between the two ornamental brackets (the sorts of the pages before); on L20, after the full stop, the opening bracket stands before وإِن, which ends the line, and the closing bracket stands on L21 after تعلَم: the words وإِن اردتَّ أن تعلَم are enclosed.

Numerals in a smaller type under bars: on L01 {ov:ص} (90; bar 13.2 pt) and {ov:رع} (270; 12.7 pt); {ov:قف} (180) on L08 (11.6 pt), twice on L12 (12.2 and 13.1 pt), on L13 (13.1 pt) and on L14 (12.4 pt); on L18 the latitudes of Saturn {ov:ج ب} (3;2; 17.5 pt) and {ov:ج ه} (3;5; 13.3 pt) and of Jupiter in the north {ov:ب د} (2;4; 14.9 pt); on L19 that of Jupiter in the south {ov:ب ح} (2;8; 18.4 pt) and those of Mars {ov:د كا} (4;21; 13.6 pt) and {ov:ز ز} (7;7; 12.5 pt); on L20 that of Venus {ov:ح نو} (8;56; 16.6 pt) and that of Mercury {ov:د يح} (4;18), whose bar is printed in two pieces (5.0 and 7.9 pt, together 13.3 pt). The hā' of {ov:ج ه} is printed as a small filled ring. In يح the yā' stands as a tooth over the ḥā' and its two dots as one flat dot in the bowl of the ḥā' (2.2 x 1.4 pt), as in the same numeral on p. 173.

The note figures: the figure 1 stands on L07 after الثالث; the figure 2 on L12 after شَماليّ; the figures 3 and 4 on L13 after the two جَنوبيّ; the figure 5 on L14 after شَماليّ; the figures 6, 7 and 8 on L18 after {ov:ج ب}, {ov:ج ه} and {ov:ب د}; the figures 9, 10 and 11 on L19 after {ov:ب ح}, {ov:د كا} and {ov:ز ز}; the figures 12 and 13 on L20 after {ov:ح نو} and {ov:د يح}. The notes give the readings of the codex: السادس for الثالث; the four sides of the second latitude the other way round (جنوبى, شمالى, شمالى, جنوبى, their last letter without dots); ح ب for ج ب; لج ه for ج ه; يج for ب د; يز ح for ب ح; for the two latitudes of Mars the codex has, as Plato has, و and وايضا; the last two numerals are written in the codex without dots («sine punctis», the second time shortened to «s. p.»). In the notes the numerals stand without bars; the hā' of لج ه is printed as a filled dot at the left of لج; in يج the dot of the jīm and the flat dot of the yā' stand side by side in the bowl.

L01: بالجدْول: a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and no other sign; so too الجدْول on L02 (2.5 x 2.9 pt), on L05 (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and on L09 (2.5 x 2.9 pt) (compare L07). الزُّهَرَة: over the zāy a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.8 pt), a fatha over the hā' and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt each). عطارد: no signs. بَعْدَ: a fatha over the bā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 2.2 pt). إِلْقاء: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and the last hamza on the line; so too on L08 (the hamza 2.9 x 2.5 pt and the kasra 3.2 x 1.8 pt under the alif, the sukun 2.5 x 2.5 pt). الدَّوْر: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the wāw (2.9 x 2.9 pt); so too on L02 (the shadda and the fatha in one cluster, 3.6 x 4.3 pt; 2.5 x 2.9 pt) and on L08 (2.9 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt; 2.2 x 2.5 pt). اذا and اكثر: no hamza.

L02: فأَدْخِلْه: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it, joined to the head of the alif in the master scan and apart from it in the second copy, a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the khā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.2 pt). وخُذْ: a damma over the khā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the dhāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt). بإِزائه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.0 pt), and the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.6 pt); so too on L09 (3.2 x 4.7 and 2.9 x 3.2 pt). بحِصَص: a kasra under the ḥā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the first ṣād (4.0 x 2.5 pt).

L03: الدقائق: the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt). ستّين: a shadda over the tā' (3.6 x 2.9 pt); so too on L10 (3.2 x 2.2 pt). فخذ: no signs; the dot of the fā' stands high, over the dot of the khā' (10.0 to 12.2 pt over the baseline); so too on L10. بقَدْره: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الميْل: a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and no fatha. الذي: the alif and the lām are joined by a blot in the master scan; the second copy has them clean. أَثْبَتَّ: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the thā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it, in one cluster in the master scan (4.0 x 4.7 pt).

L04: الاوّل: a shadda over the wāw (2.9 x 2.2 pt). فاحفَظْه: a fatha over the fā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the ẓā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). فإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt); so too on L11 (3.6 x 4.7 pt). المعدَّل and المعدَّلة: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt here); so too on L05, L07 and L11. بزيادة: the bā' is printed without its dot, in both copies: the dot of the zāy stands over the join of the two letters and the two dots of the yā' under the line (3.2 x 2.2 pt), and no dot stands under the first tooth, where فبزيادة on L08 has it (1.4 x 1.4 pt). The word is transcribed in full. عرَفْتَ: a short fatha over the rā' (2.5 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). دقائق: the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt).

L05: وحاصّة: a shadda over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.5 pt), without a fatha; a small dot under the wāw (1.4 x 1.1 pt) stands in the master scan only and is not transcribed. يقَعَانِ: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the nūn (3.6 x 1.8 pt). جميعًا: the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt). أيّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). النِّصْفَيْن: a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the dot of the fā' (2.9 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). إِمّا: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt); وإِمّا: the hamza (2.9 x 2.9 pt) with a kasra under it (3.6 x 2.2 pt), and the shadda (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الأَعْلَى: over the lām-alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has no dots.

L06: الاسفل: no hamza and no signs; so too on L13. فإِنّ: under the alif the hamza (2.9 x 2.9 pt) with a kasra under it (2.9 x 1.8 pt), and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L07 (the cluster 3.2 x 4.7 pt; 3.2 x 2.2 pt). اثبتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and no other sign (compare L03). جَنُوبيّ: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a damma over the nūn (2.2 x 4.3 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt), which has its two dots. والآخر: the madda over the lām-alif (9.0 x 3.6 pt) and no other sign. آخرَ: the madda over the alif (9.0 x 3.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). وان: no hamza.

L07: العَرْض: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt); العرض the eight other times on the page has no signs. شَماليّ: a fatha over the three dots of the shīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). فاعرِفه: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). ثمّ: a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt). خذ: no signs. المَرْكَز: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the long kāf (4.0 x 2.2 pt); المركز on L04 and on L08 has no signs. بالجَدْوَل: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 2.5 pt). أمّا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt); so too وأمّا on L08 (2.5 x 2.9 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). الزُّهَرة: over the zāy a shadda (3.2 x 1.8 pt) with a damma above it (2.2 x 4.0 pt) and a fatha over the hā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt); no fatha over the rā' (compare L01).

L08: عُطارد: a damma over the ʿayn (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and no kasra (compare L15). فأَدْخِل: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.3 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a short kasra under the khā' (2.5 x 1.8 pt); no sukun over the lām (compare L02). بعد: no signs. إِن: under the alif the hamza (2.9 x 2.9 pt) with a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt). فاقَه: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 1.8 pt).

L09: ايضًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt); so too on L20 (3.6 x 2.9 pt). وخذ: no signs (compare L02). دقائق: the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt). الحِصَص: a kasra under the ḥā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the first ṣād (3.6 x 2.5 pt). فأَثْبِتْها: the hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the thā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the dot of the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the tā' (2.2 x 2.9 pt).

L10: موضِعَيْن: a short kasra under the ḍād (2.5 x 1.4 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). واعرِف: a kasra under the rā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt); so too on L16 (3.2 x 1.8 pt). الموضعَيْن: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); no kasra. بقدْره: a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and no fatha (compare L03). الانحراف: no signs: the nūn stands as a small hook over the ḥā', printed apart from it, with its dot over the tip of the hook.

L11: فأثبِتْه: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a kasra under the dot of the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a sukun over the two dots of the tā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); no sukun over the thā' (compare L09). العَدَد: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the first dāl (3.6 x 2.5 pt). عرفتَ: a fatha over the tā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and no other sign (compare L04). الدقائق: the hamza over its tooth (2.5 x 3.2 pt). وقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt); a small tick between وقَع and في (1.8 x 1.4 pt) stands in the master scan only and is not transcribed. الأعْلَى: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt) (compare L05). والحاصّة: a shadda over the ṣād (2.9 x 2.2 pt); so too الحاصّة on L12 (3.2 x 2.2 pt). اقلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L13 (3.2 x 2.5 pt).

L12: فإِنّ (twice): under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 and 3.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt); so too on L13 (3.2 x 4.7 pt; 3.2 x 2.2 pt). حصَل: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.2 pt); حصل the five other times on the page has no signs. شَماليّ: a fatha over the three dots of the shīn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the figure 2 follows.

L13: جَنوبيّ (twice): a fatha over the jīm (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (2.9 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); no damma over the nūn (compare L06); the figures 3 and 4 follow. واقعًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). والحاصَّة: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) (compare L11).

L14: فإِنّه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda high over the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). شَماليّ: a fatha over the three dots of the shīn (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.9 pt); the figure 5 follows. ثمّ: a shadda over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt). خُذْ: a damma over the khā' (2.2 x 4.3 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the dhāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt). الدقائق: the hamza over its tooth (2.5 x 3.2 pt). اثبَتَّها: a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each); no hamza. الموْضِع: a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the ḍād (2.9 x 2.2 pt); no fatha over the mīm. الآخر: the madda over the lām-alif (9.4 x 3.2 pt) and no other sign. ان: no hamza. حسابك: no signs; so too on L15.

L15: للزُّهَرَة: over the zāy a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt), a fatha over the hā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). فسُدْسها: a damma over the first sīn (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ابدًا (twice): the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt each); no hamza. شماليّ: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and no fatha (compare L07). لعُطارِدَ: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the rā' (4.0 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (3.6 x 2.5 pt). فنِصْفها: a kasra under the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ورُبْعها: a damma over the rā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). جَنوبيّ: a fatha over the jīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt).

L16: العُروض: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt). الثلثة: without an alif. فاجمَعْها: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). خالَفَ: a fatha over the lām (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dot of the fā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt). فأَلْقِ: the hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.5 pt) with a fatha above it (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the qāf (2.9 x 2.2 pt). الاقلَّ: over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each). جِهة: a kasra under the jīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt); جهة earlier on the line and الجهة on L17 and on L21 have no signs. الاكثر: no hamza.

L17: يَبْقَى: a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots. يحصُل: a damma over the ṣād (2.9 x 5.0 pt). واعلَم: a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt). أنّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt). زُحَلَ: a small damma over the zāy, its tail printed apart (2.2 x 2.9 and 1.1 x 1.1 pt), a fatha over the ḥā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L18: الشَّمال: over the shīn, above its three dots, a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each); so too on L20 (3.2 x 1.8 pt each); الشمال later on L18, on L19 and on L20 has no signs. وجَده: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt). بطلميوس, الجنوب and المشتري: no signs.

L19: الجَنوب (twice): a fatha over the jīm (2.9 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); so too والجَنوب twice on L20 (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). المِرِّيخ: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.4 pt), a shadda over the rā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a short kasra under it (2.2 x 1.1 pt); the two dots of the yā' are cast in the hollow of the join of the yā' and the khā'. الزهرة: no signs.

L20: بالسَّوِيَّة: over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each), a kasra under the wāw (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); بالسويّة later on the line has the shadda over the yā' only (3.2 x 2.2 pt). عُطارد: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 5.0 pt). وإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt).

L21: اردتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); no hamza. أن: the bare hamza over the alif (3.2 x 3.2 pt). تعلَم: a fatha over the lām (4.0 x 2.5 pt). هَلِ: a fatha over the hā' (4.0 x 2.9 pt) and a short kasra under the lām (2.5 x 1.8 pt). صاعِد: a kasra under the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.5 pt). ام and هابط: no signs. فقَوِّمْ: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 2.5 pt), and a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.9 pt). بَعْدَ: a fatha over the bā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 2.5 pt). عشْرة: a sukun over the three dots of the shīn, printed as a filled dot (2.5 x 2.5 pt), in both copies. أيّام: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt).
